source.section: MD&A · Second Quarter of 2026 and Recent Highlights · Investments
source.quote: we invested $21.1 million ... under our construction in progress and capital improvement programs in our Triple-Net segment ... and we invested $0.6 million ... in our Operating segment

source.section: MD&A · Second Quarter of 2026 and Recent Highlights · Dispositions
source.quote: we sold 26 facilities (22 SNFs and four ALFs) ... for total consideration of $562.6 million and $597.1 million, respectively

source.section: MD&A · Liquidity and Capital Resources · Dividends
source.quote: On May 15, 2026, we paid dividends of $0.67 per outstanding common share to the common stockholders of record as of the close of business on May 4, 2026.
